integrity: All conclusions derived analytically using the finite-state tilted generator and reversible Poisson equation; full-configuration computations are corroborative and do not certify general parameter statements. Prior priority is assessed against specified accessible primary studies, not asserted globally.
limitations: Exactly two indistinguishable hard-core particles; undirected complete bipartite graphs; unit-rate successful hops counted at equilibrium; long-time variance-to-mean ratio. No finite-time Poisson claim beyond K_{1,3}, no claims for other graph classes or asymmetric rates.
title: Topology reversal and a unique Poisson star in two-particle exclusion activity
